basic_profile.bio: Avid dirt bike enthusiast from the Pacific Northwest, spending weekends on trails and weekdays dreaming about the next ride. I juggle a part-time job at an outdoor gear store and college classes, studying mechanical engineering. Single and loving the freedom to ride whenever the mood strikes. Typically online late evenings after a day of classes or a ride.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught in dirt bike maintenance and repairs, with a growing interest in mechanical engineering from coursework. Started riding dirt bikes at a young age, learning the ropes from family and local riding groups.
